bestiary.title: The Earth Baker
bestiary.description: A fire survives by becoming undetectable, and the mineral soil that nearly starves it is the same thing that hides it.

bestiary.title: Frost Sleeper
bestiary.description: A fire sleeps under the snow that seals it, and the men who find it open the seal in order to fight it.

bestiary.title: Bog Body
bestiary.description: A fire declared extinguished goes underground into peat, and all that is done to kill it there feeds it instead.

bestiary.title: Tinder Child
bestiary.description: A fire wakes in dry needles with no idea what it is, eats its way across three valleys, and arrives at a self.
